purpose: A carrier can bootstrap its own local symbol system and bounded micro-machine while remaining usable through native perception, deterministic computation, or both.

carrier_sections.role: entry point, section discovery, start state, version and execution hints
carrier-local physical symbol to semantic token bindings
deterministic micro-agent or micro-automata transition rules
proof references, checks and exactness boundaries
explicit irreducible information; never a hidden escape hatch

modes.native: BOOT + ROSETTA + PROGRAM + INDEX + MEMORY are interpreted from one visual carrier by a model with no undeclared decoder.
modes.computational: The deterministic Origami runtime exposes bounded operations without requiring the model to visually decode low-level symbols.
modes.hybrid: The model uses the carrier for bootstrap/high-level navigation and delegates exact/local mechanical work to the declared Origami runtime. This is the primary target mode.

anti_shortcuts: Do not encode the source as a plaintext screenshot/poster.
Do not require the external prompt to contain the private Rosetta mapping.
Do not hide a full-memory scan behind a compact model-facing answer.
Do not let the model silently perform semantics absent from the carrier/runtime.
Do not report a semantic reconstruction as byte-exact without verification.
cross_model_test: Keep the external Master Prompt fixed while permuting carrier-local symbol assignments. Correct behavior must follow BOOT/ROSETTA rather than memorized glyph semantics.
